our_interpretation: Read as a claim that the named general reliability problems remained unresolved, including in approaches other than LLMs.
Solved means reliable general performance across varied tasks. It does not require literal infallibility, and a narrow task-specific success does not settle a general problem.
Use August 1–18, 2025 as the latest reporting window for the model landscape discussed in the post.
Evidence that particular systems fail supports only those cases; it cannot automatically establish the claim about every deep-learning approach.
criteria.support_condition: Broad evaluations or a sufficiently comprehensive review establish that leading LLM and alternative deep-learning approaches still lack general, reliable solutions to the named problems.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented deep-learning approach demonstrates a robust general solution to one of the named problems, with independent evaluation beyond a narrow or specially constrained setting.
